explanation: Swiss doctor Maximilian Bircher-Benner created muesli around 1900 for patients at his Zurich clinic. His original recipe held more grated apple than oats.

claims.text: Rolled oats are the main grain in muesli.
Rice, maize and millet are not the main grain of muesli.
Muesli was created around 1900 by the Swiss physician Maximilian Bircher-Benner for patients at his clinic in Zurich.
Bircher-Benner's original recipe contained more grated apple than oats.
